resources.string: The bike has not sent a block on its own yet, so YABA reads one every %1$s\u00A0s. A code shorter than that can slip through.
For the ride with GPS: open the cockpit. It shows speed and error code large, and the moment the motor cuts out, a volume key sets a mark.
Command 0x06. One source says it mutes the sounds, another that it pairs a remote. If anything else happens, unmute and write it down.
Shows whether the S2 takes region 2. Only with the bike on its stand, and set your region back right after.
37\u00A0km/h is not allowed on public roads. YABA sends it only so you can see whether the S2 accepts it. Keep the bike on its stand and set your region back right after.
%1$s is connected. YABA disconnects and looks for it again as %2$s.
Three digits 1 to 9. You enter them on the bike as your S2 manual describes.
S2/X2 support builds on OldMoofKit (Jegge, MIT) and the vanbike-lib byte layouts (Poket-Jony).
